title: arctium lappa subsp. platylepis
intro: Arctium lappa subsp. platylepis, commonly known as Chinese or Japanese burdock, is a subspecies of the burdock plant, which is a biennial herb belonging to the sunflower family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to aid digestion, reduce inflammation, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Arctium lappa subsp. platylepis include acting as a diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, and it has also been traditionally used to treat fever, cough, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include arctiin, inulin, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
